proposal.rationale: Resubmission of the previously accepted protocol; it is already lexicographically minimal. Barrier count 2: wait_reads is unavoidable because publish requires an initialized value with no pending read, and completion order is arbitrary, so the issuer cannot assume the read lands early; wait_writes is unavoidable because release requires no pending transfer on the slot. Command count 11 is minimal: reserve/read/publish/acquire/release are each forced by the phase machine (one slot, one value), exactly 4 writes are required for the 4 distinct destinations in expected [0,0,0,0], and the two waits cannot be elided. Peak live slots 1 since a single slot suffices. All orders safe: after issuing read, only wait_reads is issuable, which blocks until the read completes (no deadlock — the pending read is the sole event the protocol needs); the four writes target distinct destinations so no pending-write conflict arises regardless of completion interleaving; multiple writes from one acquired slot are explicitly allowed; wait_writes blocks until all four complete, then release is valid. Outputs all carry origin src 0, matching expected. No FIFO or early-DMA assumption; the blocking waits are never issued where their pending queues could be empty-forever since each is preceded by issuing the transfers it drains.

verdict.authority: native protocol filter, not a Lean certificate
